name: neon-mspm0
title: TI MSPM0
description: The MSPM0 is a 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontroller family from Texas Instruments. The family is designed for cost-sensitive, low-power and real-time embedded applications, and provides integrated analog peripherals, timers, communication interfaces and device-specific hardware features.

cmsis.description: The Arm Cortex Microcontroller Software Interface Standard provides a vendor-independent hardware abstraction layer for Cortex-M processors, including processor access definitions, startup support and standardized interfaces.
cmsis.title: CMSIS
